notes.title: Update summary (Sep ~ Oct)
notes.content:
* This sentence is an automated translation of Japanese.

【add to】
· Chapters 1 and 2 (Total 4 stages)

· Added tutorial to Chapter 1-1

· MP
  -- Consumption by activating magic and technique
  -- Recovery with normal attacks and over time

·stamina
  -- Consumes over time and recovers HP
  -- Recovery with food

· Display of gauge of HP, MP and stamina

· Free field
  -- Free mode to advance anywhere with automatic field generation
  -- Monsters and food, items pop randomly
  -- Monsters and items that pop and have night and day pops change
  -- Dungeon where monsters spring up abundantly

· Add / release objects addition (valid only for free field)
  -- Hold / release objects with left and right grip buttons
  -- Sword to the left waist when released

【Change】
· Damage adjustment for ordinary attack
  -- Damage increase when shaking a large amount

· Charge input method change
  -- Fixed body position → Fixed position while inputting JoyStick of hand holding weapon

· Changing the magic triggering condition classification
  -- Magic input in horizontal direction of 45 degrees or more, creates magic crest in the sky downward
    → Magic input in a horizontal direction of 60 degrees or more, creates a magic crest in the sky downward

【Others】
· Supports OculusRift


~ Schedule for the next month ~

· Addition of content to free field
(I think that it will become the main update here for a while because it is the most enjoyable part now being developed)
  -- Addition of wood, stone, ore etc
  -- Add monster
  -- Added the function to set (fix) the object in the field
  -- Add monster drop item
  -- Weapon and armor addition equipment addition function
  ↓ If possible
  -- Forge system (shape processing of ore) + weaponization function
  -- Leveling function
  -- quest

· Add battle content
  -- Add a new chapter
  ↓ If possible
  -- Add stage with adventure elements
  -- Added stage for multi

· Improvement of graphics
  -- Adjust the texture and material of the model as a whole
  * There is a possibility that the frame rate may fall to extreme, so carefully adjust

* I am making it as a whim with my hobby, so I have a lot of schedule change.
* If you have an opinion posting, you may make it up by tensioning and leaving others.


Thanks for comments and advice :)
I will improve games by referring to these.
